title.narrative: Providing NFPs, National Teams, and local/regional stakeholders the needed technical assistance to help coordinate and implement activities on CBRN risk mitigation.

description.narrative: Implementation of two regional round table meetings (March 15th, and June 13th, 2023) engaging all 6 GCC countries (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Bahrein, Oman, and Qatar) contributing to regionallevel enhancement of cooperation on CBRN Risk Mitigation.Multiple bilateral meetings with national authorities and stakeholders for technical and cooperative discussions for planning purposes.Contributing to capacity building for medical preparedness and response to CBRN incidents in the GCC in March 2023 (P82). Planning and supporting a 2week trainthetrainers event in the UAE for all 6 GCC countries directly benefiting from highly specialized theoretical and practical training for national and regional level capacity enhancement.

description.narrative: Number of countries where safety and security measures that enhance governance and cooperation on CBRN risk detection and mitigation have been implemented at country and/or regional level

comment.narrative: All 6 GCC Countries

All 6 GCC member states were engaged in the intervention UAE Saudi Arabia Qatar Bahrein Oman and Kuwait through participation and technical exchanges with the implementor at regional roundtable and bilateral meetings in accordance with the TOR and log frame. Through support given to the CBRN medical preparedness training exercise in March 2023 all 6 GCC countries were represented through their NFPs and national experts receiving training under P82.

title.narrative: Number of persons directly benefiting from the intervention (M/W/B/G)

description.narrative: To avoid double counting, this indicator should not be used in conjunction with any other output indicator related to the aggregation of number of persons. As a rule, this indicator should be used when there is no other specific means to capture number of persons directly benefiting from the intervention. Directly benefiting means that an area of expenditure can be corelated to that individual person (M/W/B/G).

comment.narrative: The target number of persons benefiting directly form the intervention through technical administrative and strategical support for CBRN risk mitigation in all GCC countries is not easily definable at the start of the project. Indicator is mainly qualitative. To give an estimate we have idealy 6 countries where there is one National Focal Point NFP and ideally a National Team. On average such team should consist of al least 4 people and the NFP giving us 30 in total as the target.

As the GCC countries have existing technical committees to address CBRN related issues in isolation the formal establishment of National Teams NT as promoted under the EU CBRN CoE Initiative remains a priority to foster effective interagency cooperation to address CBRN risk management. The implementor has always tried to promote this EU approach and the work remains ongoing. Therefore the nature of interactions with key individuals are adhoc and bilateral

title.narrative: Number of persons directly benefiting from the intervention (M/W/B/G)

description.narrative: To avoid double counting, this indicator should not be used in conjunction with any other output indicator related to the aggregation of number of persons. As a rule, this indicator should be used when there is no other specific means to capture number of persons directly benefiting from the intervention. Directly benefiting means that an area of expenditure can be corelated to that individual person (M/W/B/G).

comment.narrative: The target number of persons benefiting directly form the intervention through technical administrative and strategical support for CBRN risk mitigation in all GCC countries is not easily definable at the start of the project. Indicator is mainly qualitative. To give an estimate we have idealy 6 countries where there is one National Focal Point NFP and ideally a National Team. On average such team should consist of al least 4 people and the NFP giving us 30 in total as the target.

As the GCC countries have existing technical committees to address CBRN related issues in isolation the formal establishment of National Teams NT as promoted under the EU CBRN CoE Initiative remains a priority to foster effective interagency cooperation to address CBRN risk management. The implementor has always tried to promote this EU approach and the work remains ongoing. Therefore the nature of interactions with key individuals are adhoc and bilateral
